summary: Opt-in browser smoke and performance workflows, run by native Node 24 using the shared scripts/e2e/harness.ts. Web source checks include these scripts under the existing tsconfig scope; syntax checking and full browser execution remain separate.
hosted_boundary: hosted-cloud-smoke signs a dedicated test account in to a deployed hosted origin named by CLASH_HOSTED_WEB_URL, visits the authenticated routes, records same-origin document and /api responses from CDP Network events with screenshots, waits on network idle, and fails on any 5xx or when a signed-in route lands on /login. report.json is written for failed runs too. It is not part of test:e2e, starts no local server, and creates no data because staging can share production storage.
artifact_boundary: host-artifacts loads prebuilt local-api artifacts by dynamic URL and checks required callable exports. Test-side consumer ports avoid stale generated declarations; full execution still requires a prepared Host build.
